βααλ.def: Baal, chief deity of the Phoenicians and other Semitic nations.

βαβυλων.def: (a) Babylon, the ancient city on the Euphrates, to which the people of Jerusalem, etc., were transported, (b) hence allegorically of Rome, from the point of view of the Christian people.

βαθμοσ.gloss: a step, a stage, a position
βαθμοσ.def: a step (of a stairway); hence: a stage in a career, a position.

βαθοσ.def: depth; deep water; met: fullness, immensity; an extreme degree; profundities, deep-laid plans.

βαθυσ.def: deep (lit. and met.); in the depths of the early morning, while still very early; profound.

βαλααμ.def: Balaam, son of Beor of Pethor on the Euphrates, a soothsayer in the Old Testament.

βαλακ.def: Balak, son of Zippor, King of Moab.

βαλλω.gloss: I cast, throw, rush, put, place, drop
βαλλω.def: (a) I cast, throw, rush, (b) often, in the weaker sense: I place, put, drop.

βαπτιζω.def: lit: I dip, submerge, but specifically of ceremonial dipping; I baptize.

βαπτισμα.gloss: the rite or ceremony of baptism
βαπτισμα.def: the rite or ceremony of baptism.

βαπτιστησ.def: the baptizer, the Baptist, epithet used only of John, the son of Zechariah and Elizabeth, forerunner of Jesus.

βαρακ.def: Barak, one of the judges of Israel.

βαραχιασ.def: Barachiah; his identity is uncertain, perhaps father of the Zechariah killed by the Zealots in the last Jewish War.

βαρβαροσ.gloss: a foreigner who speaks neither Greek nor Latin
βαρβαροσ.def: a foreigner, one who speaks neither Greek nor Latin; as adj: foreign.

βαρεω.def: I weight, load, burden, lit. and met.

βαρθολομαιοσ.def: Bartholomew, surname of Nathanael, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus.

βαριησουσ.def: Bar-Jesus, the name of the magician and false prophet at Paphos in Cyprus; he is also called Elymas.

βαριωνασ.def: Bar-Jonas, son of Jonas, the surname of Simon Peter.

βαρναβασ.def: Barnabas, a Cypriote Jew, uncle of John Mark; his other name was Joseph.

βαροσ.def: a weight, burden, lit. or met.

βαρσαββασ.def: Barsabbas, son of Sabbas, a surname of Joseph and Judas.

βαρυσ.def: heavy, weighty, burdensome, lit. and met; violent, oppressive.

βασανιζω.def: I examine, as by torture; I torment; I buffet, as of waves.

βασανιστησ.gloss: one who tortures, a tormentor, jailor
βασανιστησ.def: one who tortures, a tormentor, jailor.

βασιλεια.def: kingship, sovereignty, authority, rule, especially of God, both in the world, and in the hearts of men; hence: kingdom, in the concrete sense.

βασιλειοσ.gloss: courtiers, palaces, a body of kings, royal
βασιλειοσ.def: courtiers, palaces, a body of kings, royal.

βασιλευσ.def: a king, ruler, but in some passages clearly to be translated: emperor.

βασιλευω.def: (a) I rule, reign, (b) I reign over.

βασιλικοσ.gloss: connected with a king, royal, regal
βασιλικοσ.def: connected with a king, royal, regal, (a) an officer in the service of the king, (b) the king's country.

βασκαινω.gloss: I give the evil eye to, fascinate, bewitch, overpower
βασκαινω.def: I give the evil eye to, fascinate, bewitch, overpower.

βασταζω.def: (a) I carry, bear, (b) I carry (take) away.

βατοσ.gloss: a "bath," a liquid measure between eight and nine gallons
βατοσ.def: a "bath," a liquid measure among the Jews, containing 72 sextarii, that is, between eight and nine gallons.

βαττολογεω.def: I chatter, am long-winded, utter empty words, stammer, repeat.

βδελυγμα.gloss: an abominable thing, an accursed thing
βδελυγμα.def: an abominable thing, an accursed thing.

βεβαιοω.def: I confirm, ratify, secure, establish; pass: I guarantee.

βεελζεβουλ.def: Beelzebul, a name of Satan, the chief of evil spirits.

βελιαρ.def: Belial, a demon, and in fact a name for Satan.

βενιαμιν.def: Benjamin, youngest son of Jacob, founder of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

βερνικη.def: Bernice, daughter of Agrippa I and Kypros, and sister of M. Julius Agrippa II.

βεροια.def: Berea, a town of the province Macedonia.

βηθανια.def: (a) Bethany, the home of Lazarus, Martha, and Mary, near Jerusalem, (b) Bethany, beyond Jordan.

βηθεσδα.def: Bethesda, name of a pool in Jerusalem.

βηθσαιδα.def: Bethsaida, (a) a city of Galilee, (b) a city east of the Jordan.

βηθφαγη.def: Bethphage, a village in the neighborhood of Jerusalem, on the Mt. of Olives.

βημα.gloss: the space covered by a step of the foot, a tribunal
βημα.def: an elevated place ascended by steps, a throne, tribunal.

βηρυλλοσ.def: a beryl, a precious stone of various colors, the best known being sea-green.

βιαζομαι.gloss: I use force, violence, suffer violence
βιαζομαι.def: (a) mid: I use force, force my way, come forward violently, (b) pass: I am forcibly treated, suffer violence.

βιαστησ.def: a forceful, violent man; one who is eager in pursuit.

βιβλοσ.gloss: a written book, roll, or volume
βιβλοσ.def: a written book, roll, or volume, sometimes with a sacred connotation.

βιθυνια.def: Bithynia, a Roman province, north-west of Asia Minor and south-west of the Black Sea.

βλαστανω.gloss: I sprout, cause to sprout, make to grow up
βλαστανω.def: intrans: I sprout; trans: I cause to sprout, make to grow up.

βλαστοσ.def: Blastus, chamberlain of King Herod Agrippa I.

βλασφημεω.def: I speak evil against, blaspheme, use abusive or scurrilous language about (God or men).

βλεμμα.def: a look, glance; sight and hearing.

βλεπω.def: (primarily physical), I look, see, perceive, discern.

βλητεοσ.def: a verbal adj: one must put, that ought to be put.

βοηθεια.def: (a) abstr: assistance, (b) concr: (a technical term of nautical language), a help.

βοηθεω.gloss: I come to the rescue of
βοηθεω.def: I come to the rescue of, come to help, help.

βολη.def: a casting, throw; in acc: as measure of distance.

βολιζω.gloss: I cast the line for sounding, I sound
βολιζω.def: I cast the line (for sounding), I sound.

βοοζ.def: Boaz, son of Salmon and Rahab, husband of Ruth, father of Obed.

βορρασ.def: the north wind, hence: the North.

βουλευτησ.gloss: a member of a city council, of the Sanhedrin
βουλευτησ.def: a member of a city council, in NT of the Sanhedrin at Jerusalem.

βραβευω.def: (lit: to act as arbiter in the games), I rule, arbitrate.

βραδυνω.def: I am slow, I delay, tarry.

βροχοσ.def: a noose or snare; a cord.

βρυχω.def: I grind or gnash, as with the teeth for rage or pain.

βρυω.gloss: I cause to gush forth, send forth
βρυω.def: I cause to gush forth, send forth.

βρωσισ.def: (a) abstr: eating, (b) food, a meal, (c) rust.

βυθιζω.def: I cause to sink; mid: I sink, submerge, drown.

βωμοσ.def: an altar, platform; a slightly-elevated spot.
